second_independent_supported_sek_evaluat.purpose: Nytt första blint prov av giltiga syntetiska SEK-underlag på separat granskad Node-workerfix.
scope_limitations: Small controlled synthetic cohort: six Swedish and six English invoices, SEK, three balanced layout families, one recipient and one VAT rate. Not production-wide quality.
Organization numbers have validated format and Luhn; no actual legal entity or company-register verification.
Direction is supplied metadata, excluded from nine image-field metrics.
Node and Sites share the same14 OCR observations and are not independent document populations.
Observed100% precision62/62 does not establish true population precision>=98%; zero green predictions gives no green-accuracy sample.
The different cohorts cannot establish a causal effect of the worker fix on the first cohort's four unexplained failures.
second_independent_supported_sek_evaluat.criterion10_reassessment: Retain 6.5. The actual supported-normal first pass has 57.41% recall, below 85%. Successful worker completion does not justify an accuracy score increase.
